content: The effects of antithrombin III may be altered by an unknown mechanism. It is recommended to avoid or use an alternative drug. Apalutamide decreases the level or effect of quinine by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with drugs that are CYP3A4 substrates can result in reduced exposure to these medications. Avoid or substitute another drug when possible. If co-administration is necessary, evaluate for loss of therapeutic effect and adjust the dose according to prescribing information. Close monitoring is advised. Both apomorphine and quinine increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Aprepitant increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Arformoterol and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine increases the effects of argatroban by an unknown mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Aripiprazole and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Armodafinil decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Arsenic trioxide and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Artemether and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Artemether/lumefantrine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Monitor closely. Artemether/lumefantrine decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Asenapine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Asenapine transdermal and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Atazanavir increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Quinine increases the level or effect of atogepant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Atomoxetine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Quinine increases the effects of atracurium by pharmacodynamic synergism, leading to a risk of respiratory depression. This combination is contraindicated. Monitor closely. Quinine increases the level or effect of avapritinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine increases the levels of axitinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Azithromycin and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine and bedaquiline both increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. ECG monitoring is recommended. Quinine increases the effects of bemiparin by an unknown mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Quinine increases levels of berotralstat by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Berotralstat also increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Adjust the dose of narrow therapeutic index drugs that are CYP3A substrates when co-administered with berotralstat. Quinine increases levels of betrixaban by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Reduce the betrixaban dose to 80 mg orally once, then 40 mg orally daily if co-administered with a P-gp inhibitor. Quinine increases the effects of bivalirudin by an unknown mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Blinatumomab increases levels of quinine by decreasing its metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. During the initiation of blinatumomab, transient cytokine release may suppress CYP450 enzymes, increasing the risk of drug-drug interactions, particularly during the first 9 days of the first cycle and the first 2 days of the second cycle in patients receiving concomitant CYP450 substrates. Bosentan decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Bosutinib and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Bremelanotide decreases the level or effect of quinine by slowing gastric emptying, potentially reducing the absorption of oral medications. Avoid use with oral drugs dependent on threshold concentrations for efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Quinine increases the level or effect of brexpiprazole by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Administer a quarter of the brexpiprazole dose if co-administered with a moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor plus a strong/moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Brigatinib decreases the level or effect of quinine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, monitor CYP3A4 substrate levels and adjust the dose as needed. Brodalumab may normalize CYP450 enzyme formation by reducing cytokine levels during chronic inflammation. Upon initiation or discontinuation of brodalumab in patients receiving concomitant CYP450 substrates, particularly those with a narrow therapeutic index, monitor for therapeutic effect. Budesonide decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Quinine and bupivacaine implant may increase each other's toxicity. Use caution and monitor closely. Local anesthetics may increase the risk of methemoglobinemia when co-administered with drugs that also cause methemoglobinemia. Buprenorphine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. This applies to buprenorphine in all forms, including buccal, subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection. Butabarbital decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Butalbital decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Capecitabine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Carbamazepine decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cenobamate decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when co-administered with cenobamate. Quinine increases levels of ceritinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Ceritinib and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Ceritinib also increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Chloroquine increases the toxicity of quinine by prolonging the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Chlorpromazine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of quinine by competing for renal tubular clearance and by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Ciprofloxacin and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Ciprofloxacin has minimal effects on the QT interval but should be used cautiously in combination with other QT-prolonging drugs or in patients with risk factors. Quinine increases the effects of cisatracurium by pharmacodynamic synergism, leading to a risk of respiratory depression. This combination is contraindicated. Monitor closely. Quinine and citalopram both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. ECG monitoring is recommended. Clarithromycin and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Clarithromycin also increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clomipramine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Clozapine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Cobicistat increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine increases the level or effect of colchicine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid colchicine with P-gp inhibitors, especially in patients with renal or hepatic impairment. Conivaptan increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Cortisone decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Crizotinib increases levels of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Crizotinib and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Dose reduction may be needed for co-administered drugs metabolized by CYP3A. Crofeler increases levels of quinine by inhibiting CYP3A4 in the gut. Systemic inhibition is unlikely due to minimal absorption. Use caution and monitor closely. Cyclophosphamide increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Cyclosporine increases the level or effect of quinine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine increases the level or effect of dabigatran by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Avoid co-administration of dabigatran with P-gp inhibitors in patients with renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min for atrial fibrillation or <50 mL/min for DVT/PE treatment). Dabrafenib decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Quinine increases the effects of dalteparin by an unknown mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Danazol increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Danicopan increases the level or effect of quinine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Consider dose reduction of P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious adverse reactions. Quinine and topical dapsone may interact through an unspecified mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of topical dapsone with oral dapsone or antimalarial medications due to the potential for hemolytic reactions. Darifenacin increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Darunavir increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Dasatinib and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Dasatinib also increases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely. Deferasirox decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Degarelix and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Desflurane and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Desipramine and quinine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. Quinine and deutetrabenazine both increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. At the maximum recommended dose, deutetrabenazine does not prolong the QT interval to a clinically relevant extent. Certain circumstances may increase the risk of torsades de pointes or sudden death in association with QTc-prolonging drugs (e.g., bradycardia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, co-administration with other QTc-prolonging drugs, or congenital QT prolongation). Dexamethasone decreases the level or effect of quinine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. Monitor closely.
